$comment: Minimal demo contract: one agent returns a short summary plus a self-assessed ok flag. Used by examples/minimal.workflow.json.
title: SummaryResult

summary.$comment: Human-readable result for the orchestrator UI / complete payload; keep it concise.

ok.$comment: Agent-owned success signal (not the same as the host agent.success). Set true only when summary is usable.
ok.description: Whether the step succeeded on its own terms
